name: High Elven Grammar and Translation Specification
purpose: Machine-readable grammar rules for the original Aethelgard High Elven language, supporting a deterministic B-dictionary workflow.
core_principles: Every translated lexical item must have a stable ID.
Do not infer an unknown word from visual similarity to another word.
Do not use English/Common-looking roots as approved native vocabulary.
Native speakers may shorten or omit particles in casual speech; archival-trained speakers retain more explicit morphology.

Lyra's language is literary and treaty-trained rather than conversationally fluent; her mistakes should be grammatical hesitation, register mismatch, forgotten vocabulary, or overly literal construction rather than random nonsense.

sentence_patterns.use: military command when subject is obvious

questions.notes: Formal questions favor explicit status and evidential marking.

evidentiality.meaning: known by direct witness or established record

features: invocations against bloodline, roots, house, memory, or canopy protection

translation_rules.rule: Common to High Elven must select an exact approved lexical entry where one exists.
If no exact entry exists, return UNKNOWN and flag the phrase for lexicon expansion.
Do not silently substitute a synonym merely to make a sentence sound fluent.
Preserve register; a military command should not be translated into courtly phrasing unless the source explicitly requires it.
Names remain unchanged unless the database contains an established native form.
Romanization is deterministic and reversible; it is not the in-world Veyrath glyph system.
A phrase-level entry overrides word-by-word composition when the phrase has an established idiomatic meaning.

failure_modes: occasional archaic vocabulary when a modern term would be expected
lyra_profile.prohibited_behavior: Lyra should never suddenly speak flawless colloquial High Elven for an extended exchange without narrative justification.

features: fear and disgust vocabulary when addressing or discussing Valerius-affiliated outsiders
